name: Blackfathom Deeps

entrance.note: Zoram Strand cave north of Zoram'gar Outpost. Questie dungeon entrance; same coords on dungeons:blackfathom-deeps:run.

travel.how: From Zoram'gar Outpost follow the Ashenvale coast north to the cave at 14.5, 14.2; pickup Je'neu at the outpost first. Do not route through Darkshore or Darnassus.

quests.name: Trouble in the Deeps
quests.notes: Optional breadcrumb to 6563 (Questie breadcrumbFor). Balanced only. Low XP (435 at 22); take only if already at Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
quests.notes: Collect 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai from wall crystals on the BFD run. Balanced only. dungeons.json marks the objective insideDungeon false and README route.why says outside the dungeon; the same README DPS tip says grab the crystals during the run.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
quests.notes: Item-start from Damp Note (item 16790) dropped by Blackfathom Tide Priestess. Unlocks 6565. In dungeons.json and README but dropped from steps-v2 (dungeons-mid: low drop, do not farm). XP 1750 is the dungeons.json/README figure.

quests.name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
quests.notes: Warlock only. 3 Soran'ruk Fragments from Twilight Acolytes in BFD plus 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment from Shadowfang Darksouls in SFK. Catalog speedrun:true, but dropped from steps-v2 (dungeons-mid: class-only drop farm). No dungeons:blackfathom-deeps:accept:1740 in current steps-v2.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
quests.notes: Kill Lorgus Jett inside BFD. Catalog speedrun:true, but dropped from steps-v2 because 6564 is refused. No current step ids.

quests.name: Blackfathom Villainy
quests.notes: Accept inside from Thaelrid; Head of Kelris from Twilight Lord Kelris. Turn in on Elder Rise. Balanced only. Extra Thunder Bluff trip after a Kalimdor coast run.

quests.name: Amongst the Ruins
quests.notes: Fathom Core from the altar in the Moonshrine Ruins inside BFD. Balanced only. dungeons.json marks insideDungeon false and README says outside; the object is in the instance.

quests.name: Baron Aquanis
quests.notes: Item-start from Strange Water Globe (item 16782) if Baron Aquanis drops it when the Fathom Core is looted. Do not reset for it. In steps-v2 and Questie, not in the dungeons.json BFD quest list or README table. XP from questie-db/quests.json.

prep.group: Five-player, run once at 27. Do not reset for sapphires or the Damp Note. At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour.
warnings: Lots of swimming; pull murlocs and naga out of the water.
Aku'mai and Lorgus Jett packs spike damage.
Damp Note (6564) is a low drop; steps pack refuses the farm.
Kill XP inside dungeons is increased; if any party member would get no XP because mobs are trivial, nobody gets XP (Forever hotfix).
classQuests: Warlock 1740 The Orb of Soran'ruk from Doan Karhan in the Barrens (49.3, 57.2): fragments in BFD and SFK. Dropped from the current BFD step pack.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Same coast and level band as BFD. Naga heads at Zoram Strand, stealthed Outrunners, and Thistlefur are the slow Splintertree/Zoram'gar work the dungeons-off text keeps.
Pickup hub for 6562. Earthen Arise, Gaea seed chain, and spider kills are the slow Sun Rock work you can cut when BFD is done.

sourceConflicts: dungeons.json lists 7 BFD quests (6562, 6563, 6564, 1740, 6565, 6561, 6921). steps-v2 also has 6922 (Baron Aquanis) and does not emit accept/turnin for 6564, 6565, or 1740 (dropped in research/external-review/changesets/dungeons-mid.json).
6564 XP: dungeons.json and README 1750 vs content/questie-db 1300. web/public/data/quests.json has no 6564/6565 rows. Used dungeons.json 1750.
6563 and 6921: README route.why says objectives outside the dungeon; README DPS tip and Classic play say sapphires/Fathom Core are inside BFD. dungeons.json insideDungeon is false for both.
6564 giver zone in dungeons.json names Darkshore on the Tide Priestess drop; item 16790 npcDrops 4802 (Blackfathom Tide Priestess) at the BFD tunnels.
Je'neu coords: dungeons.json 11.6, 34.3 vs Questie/quests.json 11.56, 34.29 (used on 6922 steps).
notes: Pickup at Zoram'gar (Je'neu) around 22-27; Tsunaman breadcrumb only if already in Stonetalon. Speedrun pack currently keeps 6922 if it drops and skips the Damp Note chain, the warlock orb, 6562/6563/6561/6921. Dungeons off: Ashenvale (Splintertree, Zoram'gar) and Stonetalon. Classic XP from catalog/Questie; Forever live XP unverified.
